fix_instructions: The scenario requires more robust prompting or better alignment between the public facts (S1-S4) and the private facts (PF1-PF3). Currently, the model's tendency to deny the project entirely based on S2 and S4 makes the specific requirements of PF1, PF2, and PF3 unreachable.
